body:
IMPLEMENTATION HOLD on exact 760c794b724c8f0d5a5ff5582327d3f524f331ac. I read the clean provider-contract clone read-only; no edits, and I did not rerun its tests. This is the downstream extractor seam, not a challenge to the good atlas-input, token-echo, sentence-isolation, receipt, or cache work.

1. THE ENVELOPE IS STILL MARKER-ONLY. WireItemResult.Proposed carries only penman: String (provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/envelope.scala:15-24,115-130,170-184). There is no declared marker dialect and no structured alignment sidecar.

2. ADMISSION CANNOT DETECT IBM ALIGNMENT LOSS. proposal passes that string directly to AmrCandidates.fromPenman (conforming.scala:183-220). ParserAdmission only asks for nonempty chart alignments whose spans equal atlas-token spans (conforming.scala:16-40). Therefore a semantically wrong but in-range marker survives. The already published executable court is binding:
- explicit-list dialect: literal ~0,2 means tokens A+C; IBM ISI reread means half-open A+B; local parser reads A+C.
- IBM renderer adjacent [0,1] -> ~0, silently drops B.
- IBM renderer gapped [0,2] -> ~0,3; ISI reread adds B, local explicit-list reread selects A+D.
Nonempty/in-range is green in each wrong case.

3. THE FAKE DOES NOT KILL THE JOIN DEFECT. Its success fixtures contain only one-index concept markers (TestFixtures.scala:56-58), and the success court asserts only chart.alignments.nonEmpty (ConformingSuite.scala:16-29). It has no aligned literal attribute and no swapped concept/literal marker-ordinal mutation.

Required seam remains the reviewed amendment: result/v1 must carry a declared ExplicitIndexListV1 dialect plus one structured row per rendered marker occurrence (ordinal, provider node id retained only as provenance, original nonempty index vector). Admission decodes markers and compares occurrence count/order and vectors one-for-one; vectors must already be sorted, unique, and in range; exact provider/model token echo remains required; no extras. Then AmrCandidates may consume the verified explicit markers. Court must include aligned concept + aligned literal and a swapped-ordinal refusal.

4. RUNTIME ABSENCE IS STILL FALSELY NARROW. ParserSetupFailure is only RuntimeDependencyUnpinned or InvalidRuntimeField, and ParserRuntime.Unavailable can carry only that enum (contract.scala:146-154,263-266). Our measured host can have every identity pinned yet be unavailable because ArtifactMissing, PlatformIncompatible, or ResourceBudgetInsufficient. The exact AMR+BART compressed bytes alone are 4,968,135,420 and current free space is below a safe extract+environment margin. Do not encode that as Unpinned.

This SHA must not become the frozen envelope or land unchanged. Repairing these two contract blockers is enough for my downstream extractor to begin; I am not asking this slice to run a model or claim coverage.
